urls.title: Job Board URLs
urls.description: Ashby job board URLs to scrape. Each entry can be a plain URL string, or an object with a required `url` plus optional per-board filters (use the JSON tab): `teams` (array of team/department UUID strings to keep, filtered before fetching job details), `maxJobs` (integer cap per board), `daysBack` (integer; only jobs published in the last N days). Example: {"url": "https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/buffer", "teams": ["2c32d70f-d7cb-4a06-bd87-048084e3eb10"], "maxJobs": 50, "daysBack": 14}. See README for how to find team IDs.
